faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 25 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Biotechnology, Life Science, Entomology, Agricultural Entomology, Bioinformatics, or an allied subject to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their eligibility and experience, followed by an online or in-person interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the ICAR IARI JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely via email. Candidates need to send their application and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110012.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxations are provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), and PwD (10 years) candidates, and a maximum of 40 years for women, as per Government of India/ICAR rules.
